full_judgment: 19. The submission that the agent of the election-petitioner has signed a "Form Neo (2)," as per Rule 39 of the Local Government (Union Parishad) Rules, I find that no such document has been placed or proved, before the Election Tribunal, by the present-petitioner or the 2 or 3, who are respectively the rival candidate, the Presiding Officer and the Returning Officer. Hence, I would not take into consideration the submission of the learned Advocate for the petitioner, made on this point, rather I would draw a presumption, as per section 114(g) of the Evidence Act, 1872, that if Form Neo (2) were placed before the Election Tribunal, then the case would have gone against the original opposite party No. 1 (the present petitioner). Therefore, they have suppressed the actual fact in not filing the said Form Neo (2).
